surprises.head: A shutout for Jeremy Swayman
surprises.body: Swayman stopped all 24 shots, worth 2.0 expected goals. Starting goalies have a night this good about once every 10 starts.

story.head: Swayman shuts out the Rangers
paras: The Rangers’ Alberts Šmits played his first NHL game. JJ Peterka made his Bruins debut, after playing for the Mammoth. Fraser Minten and Peterka scored 52 seconds apart with less than four minutes left to put the Bruins up 2-0. Mark Kastelic added an empty-net goal with two and a half minutes left to make it 3-0.
The Bruins had a bit more of the good stuff. Jeremy Swayman was perfect for the Bruins, 24 saves on 24 shots, and Igor Shesterkin stopped 20 of 22.
Only two penalties were called all night, something the league sees about once every 20 games. The Bruins moved to 1-0-0, and the Rangers fell to 0-1-0.

items.text: It was the first game of the season for both teams, and the Bruins won their home opener.
Mika Zibanejad’s nine-game point streak against Boston ended.
Elias Lindholm extended his point streak against the Rangers to seven games.
Two of the preview’s three calls held.
